purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Journey owns one movement episode while route, itinerary, subject, service, schedule, shipment, incident, sensor and evidence masters remain external.
Person trip, vehicle journey, service journey, boarding and wider travel remain separately typed.
Requested, planned, target, predicted, observed and actual clocks remain independent assertions.
Position fixes remain evidence and do not alone establish a complete actual trajectory or journey outcome.
The candidate WM-FLW-007 relation remains a compositional reference rather than approved inheritance.
Mode, jurisdiction, trip segmentation, privacy and external conformance profiles remain deferred.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The aggregate preserves stable journey identity, kind, subject, endpoints, time basis and revision lineage.
Route, itinerary, service, schedule, person, vehicle, booking, ticket, shipment and incident cannot overwrite journey identity.
Legs, stages, calls, boardings and observation samples remain distinguishable.
Schedule and observation conflicts remain visible with source, event, record and ingestion clocks.
Disruption and recovery append successor state without rewriting the original plan or evidence.
Personal and live-location projections are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
Autonomous consequential rerouting, safety decisions, protected disclosure and irreversible destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
